## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (94%)** · Confident · Careful review
Invasive probability is under 1%, but MUSK disagrees and only 3 of 5 neighbors match.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 94%, Normal 4%, InSitu 2% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign [F5] | Mixed neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; lowers concept-model invasive term [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; concept model ties it to lower invasive risk [F3] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Well below-typical score; lowers invasive term · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 11) · context · Descriptive only; score below typical [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; lymphocytes Weak (8/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Image blur (simulated, severity 3) matters; the reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- MUSK disagrees and 2 of 5 neighbors are Normal, so Benign vs Normal may be less settled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4:** per-region probe gives P(invasive) 0.73 and 0.72; confirm no invasive tumor.
2. **Region 6:** per-region invasive probe 0.45; check for atypical cells confined within ducts.
3. **Region 11:** top region for lymphocyte, pleomorphism and mitosis scores; check nuclei and mitoses by eye.
